text_en: To the leader: Do Not Destroy. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的诗歌，交与乐官，调寄"莫要毁灭"。

text_en: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks; your name is near. People tell of your wondrous deeds.
text_cn: 我们感谢你，上主，我们感谢你， 称颂你的名号，传扬你的奇迹。

text_en: At the set time that I appoint I will judge with equity.
text_cn: “我规定的日期一旦来临， 我必定要依照公道行审。

text_en: When the earth totters, with all its inhabitants, it is I who keep its pillars steady. Selah
text_cn: 大地和众居民虽吓得动摇， 但我必使大地的支柱坚牢。” (休止)

text_en: I say to the boastful, “Do not boast, ” and to the wicked, “Do not lift up your horn;
text_cn: 我对蛮横者说：“不要再蛮横跋扈！” 我向糊涂人说：“不要再头角高露！”

text_en: do not lift up your horn on high, or speak with insolent neck. ”
text_cn: 不要举你们的角，反抗至高者， 不要再说骄傲的话反抗天主！

text_en: For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes lifting up;
text_cn: 的确，救援不从东方来，也不从西方来， 救援不从旷野来，也不从山岭来。

text_en: but it is God who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up another.
text_cn: 因为惟独天主是审判大主， 他将此人贬抑将那人高举。

text_en: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup with foaming wine, well mixed; he will pour a draught from it, and all the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs.
text_cn: 爵杯已经握在上主的手掌， 装满了起沫而调和的酒酿， 他已倒出，要地上的恶人们喝， 还要叫他们饮尽杯中的糟粕。

text_en: But I will rejoice forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
text_cn: 然而我要永远欢舞， 歌颂雅各伯的天主；

text_en: All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
text_cn: 恶人的角，我要一一打碎， 惟有义人的角才可竖起。
